real_data_sources: T8_housing_bracket.FCStd pre-installed at /opt/freecad_samples/ — real robotics bracket model
TechDraw workbench: ISO/ANSI drawing standards (third-angle projection)
Engineering drawing annotation: DIN 406/ASME Y14.5 dimension notation
verification_strategy: Parse FCStd Document.xml for TechDraw::DrawPage, TechDraw::DrawViewPart / DrawProjGroupItem (views), TechDraw::DrawViewDimension (dimensions), PDF mtime > task_start
anti_gaming_measures: DrawProjGroup counts as multiple views only when DrawProjGroupItem children present
Dimension count requires actual annotated measurements, not just text objects
PDF > 5000 bytes ensures full rendering (empty/corrupted PDFs are ~100 bytes)
